《无上愉悦》：官方 5–6 人小剧本，二十分钟一局，又短又吵。角色都来自前三个剧: No Greater Joy: an official teensy script for 5–6 players. Twenty minutes, short and loud. All characters come from the first three scripts; the key is working out whether the Scarlet Woman or the Baron is in play. Map: the clock tower square during a winter night market.
《狼人杀》：娱乐模式，不是血染——经典网杀「预女猎守」。狼人每晚刀人，守卫、女巫: Werewolf: a party mode, not Clocktower. The classic Seer / Witch / Hunter / Guard setup. Werewolves kill each night while the Guard, Witch and Seer use their powers. Day 1 elects a Sheriff (1.5 votes, sets the speaking order). By day players speak in turn and vote at once to exile; ties go to a run-off. Werewolves may self-destruct. Good wins when all werewolves are dead; werewolves win when all special roles or all villagers are dead (both at once counts as a werewolf win).
《诸神黄昏》：狼人杀的板子（娱乐模式，不是血染），只有狼人和猎人。狼人互相认识，: Ragnarök: a Werewolf setup (a party mode, not Clocktower) with only Werewolves and Hunters. Werewolves know each other and kill one player together each night. A Hunter who is out (killed or exiled) may fire one shot and whoever is hit dies; a Hunter taken out that way shoots next. By day it plays like Werewolf: Sheriff election, speeches, exile vote. Good wins when all werewolves are out; werewolves win when all Hunters are out.
《阿瓦隆》：娱乐模式，不是血染——照《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》原版规则。没有夜里杀人、: Avalon: a party mode, not Clocktower, using the original The Resistance: Avalon rules. No night kills, no executions: the Leader picks a Team, everyone votes openly, and Team members secretly play Quest cards. After Good completes three Quests, the Assassin gets one chance to name Merlin. 5–10 players.
《暗印》：原创娱乐模式，不是血染。每天天亮，每个人后颈烙上一个新的印记（♠♥♦♣: The Unseen Mark: an original party mode, not Clocktower. Every dawn each player gets a new Mark on the back of the neck (one of ♠♥♦♣) that they cannot see. Only when shut in the same house as someone can you step behind them and look at theirs (two people a day; they only learn that you looked), and others may lie to you. The bad side follows Clocktower numbers (1 Boss, the rest Henchmen): the Boss can check their own Mark twice, and a Henchman can Swap someone's Mark while looking at it. Back at the round table you talk; there is no vote. At night you write down your own Mark at home; write it wrong and it explodes. Good wins when the bad side is all dead; the bad side wins once they equal Good. 5–15 players.
《窃窃私语》：官方 5–6 人小剧本。恶魔利维坦不杀人，但处决两个好人、或者撑到: Laissez un Faire: an official teensy script for 5–6 players. The Leviathan never kills, but Evil wins if two good players are executed or the game reaches the end of day 5. The Amnesiac and Cannibal do not know their abilities. Map: the coach inn in a misty valley.
《哈罗德的复仇》（Harold Holt's Revenge，作者 Theo，官: Harold Holt's Revenge (by Theo, officially recommended): the Demon is the Leviathan, which never kills. Evil wins if two good players are executed or the game reaches day 5. The Cerenovus, Pit-Hag, Goblin and Marionette take turns stirring things up, and the Politician may switch sides at the end. Map: a harbor at high tide.
《洋葱派》（Onion Pies，作者 Tej，官方推荐）：底子是暗流涌动，新手: Onion Pies (by Tej, officially recommended): built on Trouble Brewing, so new players can jump in. New are the Pixie (mad as a Townsfolk, takes over if that player dies), the Ogre (sides with the player they choose without knowing which side that is) and the Marionette. Map: a winter night of pie baking.
《大诚小镇》（Trust，作者 Milk）：醉酒中毒很少、信息大多可信，难的是信: Trust (by Milk): little drunkenness or poisoning and mostly reliable info; the hard part is who to trust, with the Politician, the Mezepheles (say their keyword and you turn evil; everyone gets the mic page), the Marionette and the Lunatic. Map: the evening bell that keeps its word.
《横行霸道》（Outed Evil v4.5.0，作者 Manny，美术 Lei: Outed Evil (v4.5.0, by Manny, art by Lei & Moyu): runner-up at the Clocktower Script World Cup, 7–15 players. Evil steps into the open: everyone knows when the Fearmonger changes target, the Psychopath kills publicly by day, and the Goblin outs themselves when nominated. The Demon is the Imp or the Lleech (unkillable while its host lives). Good has Storyteller-driven characters like the General, Fisherman and Savant, plus the Heretic, who can flip the result.
《夜半狂欢》（The Midnight Oasis，作者 Zets，钟楼剧本博物: The Midnight Oasis (by Zets, art by the Clocktower Script Museum): a quick-start script for the experimental Carousel characters, 7–15 players. The Engineer can turn the Demon or Minions into other characters; while the Poppy Grower lives, Evil don't know each other; the Psychopath kills outright by day and plays rock-paper-scissors when executed; the Demon Al-Hadikhia picks three players who each choose to live or die, and if all three live, all three die. Occasionally a game has no Evil at all (Atheist), and then you win by executing the Storyteller; but executing the Storyteller when there is no Atheist hands Evil the win. Fabled: Sentinel, Spirit of Ivory.
《裁缝与暴乱》（作者 Sui，杭州说书人圈子里流传的极速板子）：所有善良都是女裁: Seamstresses & Riot (by Sui, a lightning-fast setup passed around Hangzhou's Storyteller circles): every good player is a Seamstress (once per game, at night, learn whether two players share an alignment) and every evil player is a Riot. By day whoever is nominated dies on the spot, with no vote, and the dead player can immediately nominate next. Day 3 must have nominations, and if a Riot is still alive when day 3 ends, Evil wins. No night kills and no other info, so it's chaos from day 1. Fabled Fibbin: once per game, a good player might get false info.
《瞒天过海》（Boozling v9，作者 Lau）：2022 年剧本世界杯冠军: Boozling (v9, by Lau): 2022 Script World Cup champion, officially published in Chinese and a common next step for newer players in the Chinese community. Good mostly has limited-use abilities: the Slayer's one shot, the Fisherman's one question, the Huntsman can rescue the Damsel, and the Golem can nominate only once all game (if the nominee isn't the Demon, they die on the spot). Evil scrambles info with the Cerenovus, Marionette, No Dashii and Drunk. Map: a tipsy tavern.
《暗流紫罗兰》（Trouble with Violets，作者 Ben Burn: Trouble with Violets (by Ben Burns): every good character from Trouble Brewing against every evil character from Sects & Violets. Good's info is straightforward, but Evil changes characters and alignments and can make all info false; Evil is favored. Map: a violet garden in the snow.
《生死未卜》（Uncertain Death，作者 Matt）：社区里口碑最稳的: Uncertain Death (by Matt): one of the community's most consistently well-loved custom scripts, built from the three base scripts plus the Marionette. Who dies, and how, is never certain: the Assassin ignores protection, the Godfather gets an extra kill, the Pukka's poison kills a night later, the No Dashii keeps neighbouring Townsfolk poisoned. The Marionette thinks they are a Townsfolk but is really a Minion sitting next to the Demon. Map: the clock tower square on the night of a wake.
《人人可玩》（Everyone Can Play，作者 Ben Burns，官方: Everyone Can Play (by Ben Burns, officially recommended): only characters from the three base scripts, mostly familiar Trouble Brewing faces. More deaths at night (Gambler, Assassin, Moonchild), some players survive execution by day (Fool, Devil's Advocate), and the Mayor can win outright by lasting to the end. New players play as usual; veterans treat it as a puzzle. Map: the clock tower square on an early spring night.
《七步成诗》：2025 剧本世界杯冠军（作者 TrashWarlock）。7 号: The Ballad of Seat 7: winner of the 2025 Script World Cup (by TrashWarlock). Nobody sits in seat 7, but it still has a character; the AI Storyteller makes its choices and speaks for it once per game. It might be Good, or it might be the Demon. New characters include the Noble, Village Idiot, Magician, Damsel and Boomdandy. Map: the coach inn during a moonlit poetry night.

《去外婆家》（Over the River，作者 Andrew Nathenso: Over the River (by Andrew Nathenson): the third official 5–6 player Teensyville script, named after "over the river and through the woods, to grandmother's house". The Grandmother watches her grandchild, the Snake Charmer may swap with the Demon, the Lunatic thinks they are the Imp, and the Recluse and Spy misregister. The map is the inn on the woodland path.
《疑心痢蛭》（A Lleech of Distrust，作者 OJ，官方推荐）：: A Lleech of Distrust (by OJ, featured): the most popular 5–6 player script. The Lleech Demon parasitises one player: while the host lives, the Lleech can't die; if the Slayer shoots the host, the host dies. The Sentinel Fabled makes the Outsider count uncertain. The map is the clocktower square in the rain.
《深夜飞车》（Late Night Drive By，作者 Aero，官方推荐）: Late Night Drive By (by Aero, featured): a 5–6 player script where the Demon may be the Imp or the Pukka, with a Psychopath who kills in broad daylight, a Tinker and a Golem: people die fast. The map is the clocktower square late at night.
《逐底竞赛》（Race to the Bottom，作者 Evin Donoho: Race to the Bottom (by Evin Donohoe, featured): a 5–6 player script whose Demon is the Vortox (Townsfolk information is all false). The Doomsayer Fabled: while 4 or more players live, each player may publicly ask the Storyteller to kill a player of their own alignment (once each). The map is the inn in cold rain.
《谁都别动》（Nobody Fucking Move，作者 Brockwell，: Nobody Fucking Move (by Brockwell, Script of the Month): a 5–6 player script. If the Alsaahir guesses the Minions and Demon, good wins at once; the Boomdandy, Psychopath, Goblin and Heretic make every move risky. The Duchess Fabled: each day three players may visit her together, and that night learn how many of them are evil (one gets a wrong number). The map is the clocktower square on a snowy night.
《话多成灾》（Chatastrophe，作者 TieGuyTravis）：202: Chatastrophe (by TieGuyTravis): winner of the 2025 Beardy Does Teensies contest. The Yaggababble Demon has a secret phrase; each time they say it publicly during the day, one more player might die that night. Everyone needs the listening page open so the Storyteller can hear. The map is the garden after the tea party.

《延长线》（Extension Cord，作者 Viva La Sam，当月推荐: Extension Cord (by Viva La Sam, Script of the Month): the second most favourited script on botcscripts. The Puzzlemaster Outsider makes one player drunk all game and may guess who once; guess right and they learn the Demon. Also the Oracle, Dreamer, No Dashii, Marionette and Boomdandy. Five Travellers can join, and the Sentinel Fabled makes the Outsider count uncertain. The map is the clocktower square on a rainy night.
《百无禁忌》（No Roles Barred，作者 Andrew Pichot，: No Roles Barred (by Andrew Pichot, script competition winner): the Demon may be Lil' Monsta (the Minions take turns babysitting), Legion (most players are Legion, and nominations voted only by evil fail) or the Vortox. Alchemist, Bounty Hunter, Poppy Grower, Fearmonger, Goblin, Boomdandy: every game is completely different. The map is the moonlit inn.
《米诺陶迷宫》（The Minotaur's Labyrinth，作者 Urba: The Minotaur's Labyrinth (by Urban Minotaur): the Knaves Loric. There are two Storytellers, one truthful and one lying, and each time you get information you pick which one to ask; at most once per game they secretly swap. Four Demons, the Cerenovus, the Witch and the Politician. The map is Ravenswood Bluff.

《抢椅子》（Musical Chairs，作者 Chuji）：人人都可能换角色—: Musical Chairs (by Chuji): anyone might change character. The Snake Charmer swaps with the Demon, the Pit-Hag transforms players, the Barber swaps characters, the Fang Gu jumps to an Outsider and the Philosopher takes someone's ability. New characters: the Cult Leader (each night takes the alignment of an alive neighbour; by day starts a cult, and if all good players join, their team wins), the King (once enough players are dead, learns an alive character each night; the Demon knows who they are) and the Choirboy (if the Demon kills the King, learns who the Demon is). The Gangster is among the Travellers. The map is the moonlit inn.

《抢椅子 · 空座位》（Musical Chairs，Will 版）：角色跟着座: Musical Chairs (Will's version): characters belong to seats. Every player starts good; the Demon and Minions sit on empty seats nobody occupies. Each night before nightfall you may secretly swap character and alignment with a player or an empty seat (twice per game), and you don't know what's on an empty seat until you take it. The Demon is the Leviathan (in play even on an empty seat), and the new Minion, the Organ Grinder, makes everyone vote with eyes closed and keeps the tally secret. The map is the Sects & Violets town.
